decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The details submitted pursuant to Condition 3 (Materials), 6 (Waste disposal), 7 (Hard and Soft Landscaping), 9 (Boundary Treatment), 10 (Landscape Management), 11 (Landscape Management Plan), 12 (Loading / Unloading), 13 (Disabled persons access), 14 (Cycle Parking), 15 (Sustainable sourcing of materials), 16 (Harvesting of rainwater), 17 (Energy Conservation), 20 (Boilers), 21 (Carbon Emissions), 22 (Surface water management) and 26 (Lifetime Homes), of planning permission 00248/520/P14, granted 08/02/2008 for the erection of two additional floors above the existing upper floors, incorporating the conversion of the existing office space, to create 14 residential units comprising 12 x 2 bedroom flats and 2 x 3 bedroom flats and the erection of a single storey rear extension to the ground floor to provide a new retail unit are considered acceptable and would, when provided, comply with Council Planning Policies IMP.1.2 (The reuse and recycling of urban land and buildings), ENV-B 1.1 (New Development), ENV-B 1.5 (Environmental Improvements), ENV-B 1.9 (Safety and security), ENV-P 1.3 (Surface water run off), ENV-P 1.4 (Waste water management) ENV-P 1.5 (Noise Pollution), ENV-P 2.4 (Recycling facilities in new developments), E.3.1 (Disabled access), H.4.1 (Housing standards and guidelines), H.4.3 (Residential Mix), H.4.4 (Provision for children's play in housing developments), H.4.5 (Associated facilities for residential developments), S.3.1 (New Retail Development) T.1.2 (The movement implications of development), T.1.4 (Car and cycle parking and servicing facilities), T.2.1 (Pedestrian access), T.2.2 (Pedestrian safety and security), T.4.3 (Traffic implications of new development) of the Unitary Development Plan and Policies Policy 3A.1, 3A.2, 3A.3,3A.5,.6, 3A.18, 3A.21, 3C.1, 3C.2, 3C.22, 4A.1, 4A.3, 4A.7, 4A.14, 4B.1, 4B.2, 4B.3, 4B.5, 4B.8, of the London Plan.
